title: Agent Uninstallation Verification
protection_body: Local endpoint users cannot uninstall or stop the agent without an administrator-generated verification token.
intro: Generate a time-limited (2-hour) authorization token to permit uninstallation on this device.
win_step2: 2. Paste this token into the verification prompt when requested.
unix_step: Run the uninstaller script with the token:
valid: Token is valid and ready for consumption.
invalid: Token is invalid, expired, or already consumed.
